author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Two people were killed and seven were injured in drone attacks across Russia’s Belgorod region, regional authorities said Thursday, in the latest reported violence along the border with Ukraine.

Officials said one man died when a drone detonated at an unspecified facility in Novy Oskol. Five people were reported injured in attacks across several other localities. In Shebekino, another man was killed when a drone struck a car, while a woman traveling in the vehicle was injured.

Belgorod has been repeatedly targeted during the war because of its proximity to the Ukrainian border. The initial report did not provide a complete account of property damage, identify all of the injured or establish whether military sites were among the targets.

The casualty figures and circumstances were reported by Russian regional authorities and could not be independently verified in the immediate account. Responsibility was attributed to Ukrainian drones by those officials. The situation remains developing, and later reports may revise the number of casualties or add details about the locations struck.
dek: Regional authorities reported fatalities in Novy Oskol and Shebekino as attacks continued across Russia’s border region.
headline: Two killed, seven injured in Belgorod drone attacks, officials say
